title: Card-on-File Authorization Terms — Start of the Advance Notice, Patient Financial Account
content:
**Term.** On the Patient Financial Account, the day from which a line's card-on-file notice is counted depends on the account. While the account is in precollection (its final-notice period), the notice of every line of the encounter is counted from the encounter's date of service. For an account not in precollection whose statement delivery channel is paperless, the notice of every line of the encounter is counted from the posting date of the encounter's first-posted deductible or coinsurance line. For any other account no different start day applies under this term.

The lines concerned are the deductible and coinsurance lines of the encounter whose post-adjudication balance is being charged to the card on file. A line's notice has run when at least the class's advance-notice days, counted in calendar days, lie between its start day and the handling date; the advance notice is 5 calendar days on the High-Deductible Health Plan Account and 0 on every other class. A line whose notice has run is covered by the card-on-file charge in full; a line whose notice has not run is not covered.

## Which start day applies

| Account status | Statement delivery channel | Start day of each line's notice |
|---|---|---|
| precollection | any | the encounter's date of service |
| any status other than precollection | paperless | posting date of the encounter's first-posted deductible or coinsurance line |
| any status other than precollection | mail | no different start day under this term |

The account status and the statement delivery channel are read from the account record on the handling date; the precollection row governs whatever the channel.

## Worked cases (hypothetical dates, 5-day notice)

An encounter's date of service is day 0; its deductible line was posted on day 20 and its coinsurance line on day 24; the handling date is day 27.

| Account | Start day | Days to handling date | Lines covered |
|---|---|---|---|
| in precollection, any channel | day 0 for both lines | 27 and 27 | both |
| active, paperless | day 20 for both lines (the first-posted line) | 7 and 7 | both |

Boundary: for an active paperless account whose first-posted line was posted on day 22, both lines have run their notice on day 27 (exactly 5 days) and neither has on day 26 (4 days).
